note: The actor flash-borrowed 88.96 WETH from two Uniswap V3 pools, unwrapped it, minted cETH, and issued ETH2X-FLI. The USDC it received came from the FLI issuance contract and the CETH from the cETH contract, not from pools. It repaid one pool in USDC and the other with newly minted FLI, so no token closes a cycle through pools, which fails the strict Q1 test even though it looks like an issuance-versus-pool arbitrage. The actor kept 0.102447 ETH of surplus, paid 0.002618 to a block builder, and sent 0.099829 to the sender. I counted that 0.099829 as the position, which is a judgement call because the contract itself nets to zero.
